card.title: Nintendo Switch No Boot, Charging, and Video Output Diagnostics

claims.statement: The USB charger fuse can be tested with a multimeter in continuity mode; continuity means it is good, while no continuity requires replacement.
claims.evidence: Checking continuity across the fuse ends.
claims.quote: Unplug the battery. With a multimeter set to continuity mode, put one probe in one side of the fuse and the other probe in the other side of the fuse. If there is continuity, good, go to step 2, if not you will need to b

claims.statement: The BQ24193 charging IC can be evaluated by checking battery cable voltages before and after a 30-minute charge.
claims.evidence: Measuring voltage across battery red cables relative to black before and after charging.
claims.quote: After that plug the battery back in and, without touching the power button, put the switch charging for 30 minutes. After the 30 minutes, unplug it of the charger, redo everything that I said. If the voltage after 30 min

claims.statement: Pin 1 of the BQ24193 should read high (5V-15V) depending on the charger when plugged in.
claims.quote: Pin 1 VBus should be high 5v-15v depending on charger

claims.statement: Shorts on the motherboard can be identified by checking continuity to ground on capacitors, where continuity on both sides indicates a short to ground.
claims.evidence: Probing capacitors with a multimeter in continuity mode with black probe on ground.
claims.quote: with a multimeter set to continuity mode, put the black probe on a good ground(...) and with the red probe check every capacitor(little brown things). It's supposed to have continuity in one of the sides of the capacitor

claims.statement: M92T36 pin 5 input line should measure between 3V to 6V when the power button is pressed.
claims.evidence: DC voltage measurement on M92T36 pin 5 or its trace capacitor with black probe on ground.
claims.quote: touch the pin 5 of M92T36(...) In that pin you are supposed to have 3v to 6v. If you have 0v or less, you have a short on that line

claims.statement: M92T36 pin 6 output line should measure between 3V to 6V, and 0V indicates a bad M92T36 chip.
claims.evidence: DC voltage measurement on M92T36 pin 6 or its trace capacitor.
claims.quote: touch the pin 6 or the capacitor on the end of the trace(...) its suppose to have between 3v to 6v. 0v in pin 6 means M92T36 is bad.

claims.statement: Failure of the PI3USB30532 chip or associated filters can cause a lack of image on HDMI docking.
claims.evidence: Verification of PI3USB30532 power and filter continuity.
claims.quote: If no image on HDMI docking - Check 3v is getting to the PI3USB(...) If all turns out to be good, it HAS to be the filters. All it can be.

claims.statement: A blank screen on firmware 7.x.x can sometimes be bypassed by leaving it charging all night and entering recovery mode, or entering RCM mode to inject Hekate payload.
claims.evidence: Software recovery and payload injection methods for firmware-related blank screens.
claims.quote: If you know that your console is in version 7.x.x, sorry but for now the only thing that you can do is leave it charging all night and trying to put it to recovery mode(...) If you don't know the version or is below 7.x.

cautions: SOURCE RISK: Using third-party docks can cause charging ports to fail or brick consoles.
SOURCE RISK: Using non-official USB-C charging cables can result in permanent damage or slower charging cycles.
SOURCE RISK: Overheating the motherboard with hot air during charging port replacement can cause the board to bubble.
card.caveats: Values measured in-circuit are for comparative reference only and may require components to be removed for accurate isolated testing.
